content.text: The day-granularity window has to start and end at midnight Central. I'll retry with yesterday's full day.
Day 1 spent $112.34 of the $112.50 daily budget, with 54 link clicks on 86,951 impressions. Next I'll look at the per-post split.
Cost per link click is about $2.05–$2.11 across all four posts. That's too close to call after one day, so I'll leave all four running and check again at the end of the flight.

The push ran Jul 28 to Jul 31 and spent $448.66 of the $450.00 budget. **I can't report trial starts.** X has no pixel on rackwellapp.com, and this account has no web or app conversion tags, so the trial starts aren't visible here. The campaign was optimized for link clicks to /trial, not trial starts.

**Flight recap** (Rackwell Back to School 2027 - US iOS Trial, US, iOS only)

| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $448.66 |
| Impressions | 351,231 |
| Link clicks | 245 |
| Cost per link click | about $1.83 |

**Per post**

| Post | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "Be honest: how many of your dumbbells..." | $196.75 | 109,884 | 108 | $1.82 |
| "Rackwell plans your week..." | $95.35 | 85,403 | 53 | $1.80 |
| "Back to school, back to lifting..." | $95.18 | 84,354 | 51 | $1.87 |
| "Classes start soon..." | $61.38 | 71,590 | 33 | $1.86 |

The "Be honest" post drew the most clicks and spend. The others cost about the same per click, so the data doesn't separate them much.

**What I set up**
- One campaign and one ad group, both activated, with the $450.00 total budget and a $112.50 daily cap.
- Placement: X timeline and profile. Targeting: United States, iOS only.
- Four approved posts promoted. I left out "We have an app!" because it doesn't mention the trial and links to the homepage rather than /trial.
- I made no changes to the posts during the flight.

The flight ended at midnight Central on Aug 1, so the ad group has stopped serving. I didn't pause it manually.

**To count trial starts next time:** add an X pixel to rackwellapp.com, or set up an iOS app conversion tag if you use an app measurement partner. Then the ad group can optimize for trial starts directly. I can set that up if you give me the pixel or app details.
